title: HS50011: Banking Theory And Practice
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: NoneCourse ContentsIntroduction to Banking: Traditional and
Modern Theories of Banking, Organizational Structure of Bank, Wholesale and
Retail Banking, Universal Banking, Stylized Facts on Banking Performance of
Banks in India; International Banking: Theory of International Banking, Trade
in International Banking Services, International Payment System, Costs and
Benefits of International Banking, Performance of Major International Banks;
Banking Structure: British, US, Japanese, Indian, Islamic and Socialist;
Competitive Issues in Banking: Measuring Bank Output, Scale and Scope
Economies, Empirical Models of Competitions in Banking; Management of Risks in
Banking: Credit Risk, Interest Rate Risk, Asset-Liability Management, Gap
Analysis, Duration Analysis, Duration Gap Analysis, Liquidity Risk, Market
Risk; Regulation and Strategic Issues of Banks in India.
